ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-lower portion of both lobes; broad black pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge and extends into the medial areas near the notch with irregular, high-contrast mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the trailing edge characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3 and 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer leading edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters of brownish-white pixel groups at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized barnacle growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, vertical linear pixel interruptions (rake marks) are visible on the interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacle clusters at lobe extremities and irregular black spotting across the white pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'spray' of dark pixel clusters located at the base of the white field on the left lobe, near the water line.
